subject.title: 请求支持 Telegram Bot 命令菜单中文化

question: Should localized Telegram command-menu descriptions be handled as a focused Telegram config/API change here, or consolidated into the broader shared slash-command i18n work at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/79458?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix adds config/API surface and translation ownership policy across built-in, custom, plugin, and skill command metadata.

options.title: Keep focused Telegram tracker
options.body: Use this issue for the Telegram custom-config and menu-registration contract while coordinating shared command metadata with the broader i18n issue.

options.title: Consolidate under broader i18n
options.body: Close this only after the broader issue explicitly includes Telegram custom-command config and built-in Telegram menu descriptions in its acceptance scope.

options.title: Declare transport-only sufficient
options.body: Treat merged transport support as enough and do not add built-in/config translations unless a maintainer later sponsors the product direction.

recommendation.title: Keep focused Telegram tracker
recommendation.body: Use this issue for the Telegram custom-config and menu-registration contract while coordinating shared command metadata with the broader i18n issue.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history across Telegram localized menu landing, Telegram custom-command config, and shared native command localization metadata.
